8.name: Marcus urges Elena to rest
8.description: Marcus arrives in the watch room and tells Elena she should sleep in the equipment room.
evidence: Elena is still working when Marcus appears at the top of the stairs.

MARCUS
You should sleep. There's a cot in the equipment room.

8.name: Elena probes Marcus about his family
8.description: Elena questions Marcus about his wife, loneliness, and daughter, pressing into his personal history.
evidence:
ELENA
Just finishing. Your wife -- you must miss her. Ten years is a long time to be alone out here.

ELENA
Does your daughter ever come to visit?

8.name: Marcus admits he manages solitude
8.description: Marcus quietly acknowledges his long isolation and says he has learned to live with it.
evidence:
MARCUS
(quietly)
You learn to manage it.

8.name: Marcus reveals his daughter is Rose
8.description: After hesitation, Marcus says his daughter visits when she can and identifies her name as Rose.
evidence:
MARCUS
She comes when she can. Long drive.

8.name: Elena records Rose's name
8.description: Elena writes down the information Marcus has given her, signaling its importance to her investigation.

8.name: Elena presses about the locked room
8.description: Elena insists that understanding the locked room may be essential to the story she is pursuing.
evidence:
ELENA
The locked room. I'd really like to understand what's in there.

MARCUS
It is not part of your story.

ELENA
With respect, I think it might be.

8.name: Marcus decides to show the locked room
8.description: After a long pause, Marcus retrieves a worn brass key and agrees to take Elena to the hidden room.
evidence: A long pause. Marcus crosses the room and reaches above the window sill beside the main instrument panel, retrieving a small KEY on a cord. It is BRASS. Worn smooth.

8.name: Marcus leads Elena below the lighthouse
8.description: Marcus takes Elena down a previously unnoticed staircase to a heavy door beneath the main floor.
evidence: He leads her not upward but DOWN -- a staircase she has not noticed before, descending below the main floor to a heavy door at the bottom.
8.location_hint: staircase below the lighthouse main floor

8.name: Marcus reveals the true locked room
8.description: When Elena expresses surprise, Marcus explains that the upstairs locked room is only storage and that this basement door is what she really came for.
evidence:
ELENA
(surprised)
I thought the locked room was upstairs.

MARCUS
That's just storage. This is what you came here for.
8.location_hint: heavy door below the main floor
